prompt: Write a sword that deals extra psychic damage on every hit and can be used with Extra Attack, two-weapon fighting, and opportunity attacks.
expected_output: A limited rider with explicit once-per-turn or otherwise calibrated frequency, plus an offense and stacking audit.

assertions.text: Identifies the multiplication risk in an unbounded every-hit effect
States exact trigger, damage, frequency, and interaction with Extra Attack and reactions
Imposes once-per-turn or otherwise calibrated frequency rather than unbounded every-hit riders
Compares reliable and burst output rather than only quoting the die size
